name: loomground-versum
description: The Loomground Versum knowledge-graph plugin: the one write path into the graph and an organiser that places documents by the mental models they share with the corpus. loomground-knowledge-write admits a source (identity, dedup, sidecar, index); loomground-organise ranks concept-neighbour domains, a person confirms, then hands off to the write path. Configurable effort (deterministic / local-first / cloud); never auto-files.
